description:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.  

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role:

As a Member Experience Associate at Industrious, you will be the heart of the member experience, truly aiming to create great days for all who enter your office. While your day may not look the same, here's what it could look like: 

- You are the first face people see while you’re preparing the office for the day: brewing coffee, setting out breakfast, and stocking shared amenities. 

- You’re proactive and take ownership over managing inventory and ordering your location’s supplies.

- You build magnificent events and take the extra time to design unique signage because you know the magic is in the details.

- You add new members into multiple systems so their first day in their office is seamless and memorable. 

- You assist a member with IT or wifi issues should they ever come up - no job is too big or too small for you to tackle.

- You dip your toe in local marketing events - ensuring any prospective member knows the true value of our flexible solutions.

- You take a walk in-tour while your Member Experience Manager is assisting another potential member.

Industrious helps companies of all sizes find their office home so that they can do their best work. Our team is rewriting the book on productivity by creating a new workplace experience. Right now it’s more important than ever that our Member Experience Associates are passionate about building relationships and community. You can effortlessly connect with your members. You know that the most meaningful interactions are rooted in trust and shared values.

We are Industrious.

We’re building a team of considerate collaborators who create great days. Come join us.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

- No member request is too big or too small for you to handle. You find yourself smiling when restocking the fridge and fixing the printer

- You’re energised by meeting people and work well in a team because you like supporting and assisting to help a larger plan come together

- You can create order out of chaos and are always planning ahead. You come up with solutions before anyone knows there is a problem

- You’re resilient. You know the value of having a routine, but you’re ready for the bumps too

- You’re willing to get your hands dirty and realise the behind the scenes work is not always glamorous

- You always look to improve and make things more efficient because staying busy is your happy speed

 

The salary for this role is £29,000 + performance bonus.

On top of that, you'll enjoy a range of perks, including private healthcare, pension, Employee Assistance Programme, corporate events, Learning & Development Grant, regular training.

We are seeking a growth leader who has built an acquisition engine from zero and thinks in lifetime value rather than first-order return.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Nubank is building a global Software Asset Management (SAM) capability to govern how software is requested, acquired, secured, provisioned, optimized, renewed, and retired across the company. Software is one of our largest and fastest-growing technology spend categories, and it carries real security, privacy, and audit exposure - every tool we buy creates licenses to optimize, access to control, contracts to honor, and data to protect.

We are looking for a senior individual contributor to lead this transformation globally. This role owns the design and implementation of Nubank's SAM operating model, working across Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), Information Security, IAM, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Data Protection, and business areas.

You will not be expected to manage a large team directly; instead, you will set the technical and operational direction for SAM and enable partner teams to execute consistently.

You own a clear goal: a trusted, governed, and cost-efficient global software portfolio - with complete inventory, right-sized licenses, controlled access, audit-ready evidence, and measurable savings.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Leading the global implementation of Nubank's Software Asset Management framework, from intake through acquisition, lifecycle management, renewal, and decommissioning.

- Establishing ETS as the operational owner of the software portfolio and creating clear interfaces with ITSec, IAM, Procurement, Legal, DPO, Finance, and business owners.

- Implementing an intake-first operating model in which software needs are assessed for catalog fit, duplication, build-vs-buy, security, open source governance, and data-protection requirements before commercial negotiation begins.

- Defining and operationalizing the Software Catalog as the single source of truth for software assets, owners, licenses, spend, contracts, renewals, usage, risk classification, and access posture.

- Driving the separation of license management from access management, partnering with IAM to ensure least-privilege access, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and reliable license reclamation.

- Designing risk-tiered workflows for SaaS, AI tools, FOSS, browser extensions, connectors, pilots, and exceptions.

- Establishing lifecycle automation, including renewal alerts, inactivity-based reclamation, ownership reassignment, offboarding workflows, and Shadow IT detection/remediation.

- Leading the Software Asset Selection Committee and defining decision criteria, escalation paths, exception handling, and governance cadence.

- Building global SAM standards, policies, RACI, controls, SLAs, playbooks, and reporting practices that meet Nubank's security, regulatory, and audit needs.

- Partnering with Procurement to improve vendor negotiations through usage data, right-sizing, duplicate-tool consolidation, and early renewal decisions.

- Defining and reporting the SAM performance framework: inventory completeness, license utilization, reclaimed spend, duplicate-tool reduction, renewal readiness, intake cycle time, access-review completion, and Shadow IT trends.

- Leading phased adoption across countries and business units, balancing global standards with local regulatory and operating needs.

- Serving as Nubank's internal subject-matter expert for SAM, ITAM
